notes: The mechanical word check includes all supplied Markdown, including tables of contents and authorities. Generated caption, signature and certification text are outside the body count.

This profile covers counsel-filed computer-prepared ordinary assigned civil motion papers submitted through NYSCEF. Review the assigned part and record for eligibility. Separate service proof or a required good-faith affirmation holds this profile.

The renderer does not generate navigation bookmarks. Above 4,500 measured whole-paper words, the available PDF inspection can read outline titles and destination pages but cannot establish exact internal destinations. Hold for sourced unprofiled production and independent PDF verification.

rules.notes: Legible black type, caption and paper identification, printed name below signature and filer contact information. Electronic copies must be reproducible in the prescribed format.

Place the index and assigned judge to the right on the first page. The profile uses Letter, 12-point type and double-spaced body text with a footer inside the one-inch boundary. Verify appropriate proof of service and applicable electronic bookmarks.
The NYSCEF notification records proof of service for participating recipients when effective. Other service requires its own proof as applicable.
Ordinary notice form, applicable supporting papers and grounds, place and time, relief, recipients, conferral and part-specific procedures.

Covered computer-prepared opening papers use 7,000 words and replies use 4,200. Check cross-motion posture, court permission, separate counsel certification and the distinct treatment for evidentiary and handwritten or typewritten papers.
